{{Quote|Captain Quasar! All four Merson ships have just swung in our direction!"<br />"Mr. Rork is correct. Unless I miss my guess, those ships are preparing to attack.|Rork and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="marvel24" />}}
'''Rork''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a crewman on [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quasar (Human)|Quasar's]] [[pleasure cruiser]] during the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Rork was aboard Quasar's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] during a journey through the [[Merson asteroid belt]] when they noticed [[Merson pirates/Legends|Merson pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] tailing their ship. Unschooled in the ways of war and not certain what to do, Quasar dispatched Rork to summon [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was traveling aboard the ship, as the captain wanted his counsel. Before long, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ships attacked the pleasure cruiser, and Quasar turned over command of his ship to Kenobi. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then directed Rork on when to fire the cruiser's [[energy cannon]]s in the ensuing battle, and his guidance proved instrumental to victory.<ref name="marvel24" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rork made his first and only appearance in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[Star Wars (1977) 24|''Star Wars'' (1977) 24]], written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]] and released in [[1979]]. Rork was illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]].<ref name="marvel24" />
